# graylog_user (Resource)

Manages a Graylog user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graylog_user" "example" {
  username = "terraform_user_example"
  password = "replace-with-secure-password"
  email    = "terraform@example.local"

  first_name = "Terraform"
  last_name  = "User"

  roles = [
    "Reader",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Username.

### Optional

- `email` (String) User email.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `full_name` (String) Full name.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password used only at create time.
- `roles` (Set of String) Role names assigned to user.
- `service_account` (Boolean) Whether user is a service account.
- `session_timeout_ms` (Number) Session timeout in milliseconds.
- `timezone` (String) Timezone.

### Read-Only

- `account_status` (String) Current account status.
- `external` (Boolean) Whether user is externally managed.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Effective permissions reported by Graylog.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether user is read only.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import graylog_user.example 69babedb10ce598257cccd24
```
